items.source: While it is possible for a EntityCallback to declare that it throws arbitrary exception types, any checked exceptions thrown from a EntityCallback are wrapped in an UndeclaredThrowableException since the callback mechanism can only handle runtime exceptions. Entity callback processing is stopped on the EntityCallback that raised an exception and the caused exception is propagated to the caller.
items.translation: 虽然 `EntityCallback` 可以声明抛出任意类型的异常，但由 `EntityCallback` 抛出的任何受检异常都会被包装在 UndeclaredThrowableException 中，因为回调机制只能处理运行时异常。当 `EntityCallback` 抛出异常时，实体回调处理将停止在该处，且引发的异常会被传播给调用者。

items.source: An EntityCallback can generically declare the domain type that it is able to process by specifying the generic type parameter <T>. When registered with a Spring ApplicationContext, callbacks are filtered accordingly, with the callback getting invoked for assignable domain objects only.
items.translation: EntityCallback 可以通过指定泛型类型参数 <T> 泛化地声明其能够处理的域类型。当将其注册到 Spring ApplicationContext 时，回调会根据此类型进行过滤，仅对可赋值给该类型的域对象触发调用。

items.source: Multiple entity callbacks are invoked sequentially with the result of the previous callback. Callbacks are unordered by default. It is possible to define the order in which listeners for a certain domain type are to be invoked. To do so, add Spring's common @Order annotation or implement Ordered.
items.translation: 多个实体回调按顺序依次调用，前一个回调的结果将作为下一个回调的输入。默认情况下，回调是无序的。可以定义特定领域类型监听器的调用顺序。为此，可以添加 Spring 通用的 @Order 注解，或者实现 Ordered 接口。

items.source: A EntityCallback interface needs to define a callback method accepting an object of the parameterized type as its first argument followed by additional optional arguments.
items.translation: EntityCallback 接口需要定义一个回调方法，该方法接受一个泛型类型的对象作为第一个参数，随后是其他可选参数。

items.source: Typically, entity callbacks are invoked after publishing events.
items.translation: 通常情况下，实体回调会在发布events之后被调用。

items.source: T - Entity type used to detect callbacks to invoke via their generic type signature.
items.translation: T - 用于检测以泛型类型签名调用回调的实体类型。

items.source:
Marker interface for entity callbacks to be implemented in specific callback subtypes. Intended for internal usage within store specific implementations.

Ordering EntityCallback
items.translation:
实体回调的标记接口，用于在特定的回调子类型中实现。专为存储特定实现内部使用而设计。

排序 EntityCallback
